name: Morovis (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided vertically: the yellow hoist charged with the black eagle of the coat of arms with its head turned towards the flagpole, the fly of seven vertical stripes of red and yellow.
history: Morovis is a town and municipality in central Puerto Rico. In an unusual arrangement, the eagle of the arms is shown on the flag with its head turned towards the flagpole.

features.role: eagle of the arms with its head turned to the hoist
seven stripes of red and yellow
